title: Construction of an early diagnostic model for pulmonary hypertension based on aging-related signature genes and identification of potential therapeutic targets.
summary: LASSO, random forest and support-vector-machine feature selection identified six senescence-related genes for a pulmonary-hypertension nomogram. The model had AUC 0.974 in training and was evaluated in external datasets; single-cell RNA sequencing and qPCR in an in-vitro hypoxia model checked core-gene expression. These analyses do not establish clinical diagnostic benefit or therapeutic efficacy.
